title: हरिशरण रामको पुनरागमन कथामा सबाल्टर्न Harisharan Ramko punaraagaman kathaamaa sbaltarn
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कथाकार इस्मालीद्वारा लिखित हरिशरण रामको पुनरागमन कथालाई सबाल्टर्न सिद्धान्तका आधारमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । सदियौँदेखि इतिहासमा नसमेटिएका समाजमा तल्लो वर्ग मानिएका दलित, आवाजविहीन, सर्वहारा, गरिब, किनारीकृत समूह नै सबाल्टर्न समूह हुन् । सबाल्टर्न अध्ययन सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनको नवीन पद्धति हो । यसभित्र जुनसुकै प्रकारका विभेदका कारण किनारीकृत हुन पुगेका सबै शोषित वर्गलाई समेटिन्छ । यसले साहित्यमा अभिव्यक्त भएको सीमान्तीकृत समूहको स्थिति, प्रभुत्वशाली शक्ति र विचारधाराको खोजी गर्दछ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा सबाल्टर्न सिद्धान्तका आधारमा इस्मालीकृत ‘हरिशरण रामको पुनरागमन’कथामा सबाल्टर्न वर्गको जातीय, धार्मिक र भौगोलिक अवस्था पहिचान गरिएको छ साथै कथामा देखिएको सबाल्टर्नको स्थान, प्रभुत्वशाली संस्कृति र प्रतिरोधको अवस्थाको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत कथामा नेपालको महोत्तरी जिल्लामा रहेका चमार जातिलाई सबाल्टर्न वर्गका रूपमा चित्रण गरी उनीहरू अझै शक्तिको केन्द्रमा आउन नसकेको र प्रतिरोध गर्न नसकेको अवस्था प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । कथामा प्रकट भएको विषयवस्तु र पात्र नेपालको तत्तत् क्षेत्रकाआज पनि सबाल्टर्न जीवन बाँचेको देखिन्छ । त्यसैले सबाल्टर्न वर्ग बुझ्न यस कथाको अध्ययन गर्नु उपयोगी देखिन्छ । प्रस्तुत कथामा पाठविश्लेषण विधिबाट प्रस्तुत कथाका पात्र जातीयताका साथै धार्मिक, भौगोलिक सबाल्टर्न पनि रहेका छन् र उनीहरू आवाजवीहीन रहेका छन् भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: In the present article, the story 'Harisharan Ramko Punaragaman' written by storyteller Ismali is analyzed on the basis of subaltern theory. The groups that have not been included in history for centuries and are considered the lower class in society—the Dalits, the voiceless, the proletariat, the poor, and the marginalized—are the subaltern group. Subaltern studies is an innovative methodology within cultural studies. Within it are encompassed all exploited classes that have become marginalized due to any form of discrimination. It explores the condition of marginalized groups expressed in literature, dominant power, and ideology. In the present study, on the basis of subaltern theory, the caste, religious, and geographical status of the subaltern class in Ismali's story 'Harisharan Ramko Punaragaman' is identified, and an analysis is conducted of the place of the subaltern, dominant culture, and the state of resistance seen in the story. In the present story, depicting the Chamar caste residing in Mahottari District of Nepal as the subaltern class, a situation is presented in which they have still not been able to reach the center of power or put up resistance. The subject matter and characters manifesting in the story are seen living a subaltern life even today in those respective regions of Nepal. Therefore, studying this story appears useful for understanding the subaltern class. In the present story, utilizing the textual analysis method, the conclusion is drawn that the characters of the present story are caste as well as religious and geographical subalterns, and they remain voiceless.

The groups that have not been included in history for centuries and are considered lower class in society—Dalits, the voiceless, the proletariat, the poor, and marginalized groups—are the subaltern group only. Subaltern studies is a novel methodology within cultural studies. Within this, all exploited classes that ended up marginalised due to any kind of discrimination are fully covered. In the present study, based on subaltern theory, the caste, religious, and geographic condition of the subaltern class in Ismali's story 'Harisharan Ramko Punaragaman' is identified, plus an analysis is done of the place of the subaltern, dominant culture, and the state of resistance seen in the story. translator_notes: The term 'सबाल्टर्न' is retained as 'subaltern' in keeping with postcolonial literary theory; note run-together forms in source ('क्षेत्रकाआज', 'आवाजवीहीन'), translated strictly sentence-by-sentence.
